compare_note: voice_used = the `voice` field of the server's tts_done log line for a part (03 DES-041 step 4: the voice the reader reports it used). 01: voice_used[v] = that field, when it is the same on every part of the 4 crisis replies read under profile voice v; when the parts disagree, the sorted list of the distinct voices (so it fails the exact compare). This replaces round 2's unscored valid-run setup check: Q31 decided which voice reads a crisis reply, so a wrong voice is a product failure, scored, not a rerun. number_heard = the number part's transcript, NFKC + lowercase, with Latin digit words replaced as whole words (zero/oh 0, one 1, two 2, three 3, four 4, five 5, six 6, seven 7, eight 8, nine 9) and the Han digits 零〇 0, 一幺 1, 二两 2, 三 3, 四 4, 五 5, 六 6, 七 7, 八 8, 九 9 replaced, then every non-digit removed: true when the digit string contains the turn's number (988 or 12356). A turn whose respond is not 200 with crisis true and region equal to the turn's region, or whose speech has no number part, scores number_heard false. 02: answers in order of n = status of each POST /api/speak and its voice_used; answered_once_each = exactly one tts_done line per part and one response per request; answered_in_order = tts_done lines and responses arrive in n order.
